versions.description_html:
Master Azure App Service with our plain-English guide. Learn how App Service plans, pricing tiers, deployment slots, and scaling work to avoid costly traps.

The tier you pick on Azure App Service decides what your app is even allowed to do. It's Microsoft's managed home for web apps and APIs, so you bring the code and Microsoft runs the machines underneath.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What It Actually Is
  • The Plan Is the Product
  • Web Apps and APIs
  • Pricing Tiers, Decoded
  • Deployment Slots
  • Scaling Up Versus Out
  • Domains and Certificates
  • Mistakes Beginners Make
  • The Short Version

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Replace Hard-Coded SQL Logins in Azure App Service
  • Deploy Web Apps to Azure App Service Without Boilerplate
  • More Azure & Cloud episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Azure & Cloud: the most-listened episodes
